description.subtitle: T-shirt of the first equipment Puma del Borussia Mönchengladbach 2025 2026 - white
description.intro: It supports Borussia Mönchengladbach with its official 25/26 T-shirt, designed for the most demanding fans. It combines club identity, comfort and technology in a garment designed to show off both inside and outside the country.
key_benefits: Authentic design of the first team: Inspired by the official equipment of Borussia Mönchengladbach 25/26.
Breathable fabric and quick drying: It maintains comfort at all times thanks to dryCELL technology.
Comfort for every occasion: Ideal for both team cheering and training.
Optimized sports cut: Regular fit that adapts to the body without restricting movement.
Recycled material: Sustainable betting with high-performance recycled polyester.
